I have grown beans on this 0.21 ha plot for many seasons, and I know beans do not need chemical fertilizer like maize does — I save my cash for the bigger plots where fertilizer matters more. Because I own this land, I will apply manure from my cattle to keep the soil good, and I will plant my own saved local bean seed as I always do. I will not spray chemicals or irrigate; Thyolo gets enough rain, and my family can manage the weeding by hand. I expect my family will spend about 30 days working this plot from planting to harvest, but I will not hire anyone because the plot is small and I must watch my money carefully.
